You step into the gap and strike, showing your companions exactly where the line will break.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
One creature within reach of your melee weapon.
Duration
Immediate attack. Dazed uses normal decay; each Boon expires when used or at the start of your next turn.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Once on your turn.
Type
Signature
Weak
deal 2 physical damage.
Standard
deal 4 physical damage and choose one effect.
Strong
deal 6 physical damage and choose two different effects.
  • Break Their Guard: The target gains Dazed 1.
  • Open the Line: Each ally within 5 squares who can see or hear you may move 1 square without provoking.
  • Point the Way: Each ally within 5 squares who can see or hear you gains 1 Boon to their next attack against the target.
